qualitative_targets.statement: Neither MREE nor Duke reaches campaign-end breakeven in the canonical one-year ISRU lifetime case.
Duke gives a broader range of breakeven cases than MREE; longer ISRU lifetime improves breakeven.

figure_targets.metric: Duke cumulative cost ratio time history

tolerance_policy.exact: only for exact algebra/fully specified numeric target; abs error <= 1e-9 * max(1, abs(target))
tolerance_policy.close: relative error <= 0.01 for a numeric target with adequate published precision
tolerance_policy.approximate: relative error <= 0.05 with documented reconstruction differences
tolerance_policy.unresolved: missing native inputs, incomplete logistics, or no numeric target; never classify from qualitative agreement alone

notes: No graphical values guessed and no calibration against reported outputs.
